card.hidden_placeholder: Changelog popup (button hidden on the dashboard)

warning.no_source: Choose an entity or a markdown file for your changelog in the card editor.

source.label: Changelog source
source.helper: Where the changelog text comes from.

entity.label: Entity
entity.helper: The entity that holds your changelog. Markdown is supported.

attribute.label: Attribute (optional)
attribute.helper: Read the changelog from an attribute instead of the state. Attributes aren't limited to 255 characters.

url.label: File URL
url.helper: A markdown file, e.g. /local/changelog.md for config/www/changelog.md. No length limit.

hide_button.label: Hide button
hide_button.helper: The popup still opens automatically when the changelog changes.

auto_open.label: Open automatically
auto_open.helper: Open the popup the first time each user loads the dashboard after the changelog changes. When off, the button shows a dot instead.
